name: CS/LR-3
description:
The CS/LR-3 is a bolt-action sniper chambered in 5.8x42mm DBU-141 which, paired with a free-floating barrel design, improves accuracy significantly compared to earlier snipers used by the People's Liberation Army.

High muzzle velocity and a fast bolting speed, but relatively low damage compared to other snipers.

Community submitted model.
